audit.why: HARD at 8/10 with a 47.22% win rate is defensible: the lane is genuinely losing through level 5 and Karma reclaims it from 6 and items onward, which is exactly what the prose describes.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 1 was given to Karma while its own why says 'you simply cannot trade into him at level 1'; Level 2 was Skill while its why says you cannot escape once he is on you; first item was Pantheon while its why calls it an 'Even window'; 2+ items was Pantheon while its why says he 'falls off a cliff' and you reclaim the duel.
audit.why: Pantheon front-loads levels 1-5 and decays into items; Karma's power arrives at 6 and again with AP/haste components. The packet levelChart states exactly that.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 1, 5 and 6 flipped in matched pairs, giving Pantheon / Pantheon / Pantheon / Pantheon / Karma / Skill / Karma.

audit.whatIsWrong: Five places claim 'his Aegis passive auto-blocks your autos and the spears he throws'. Pantheon's passive is Mortal Will — 'every few spells or attacks, Pantheon's next spell is empowered'. Nothing in it blocks anything. The blocking is Aegis Assault (E), an active 22/21/20/19/18s channel that only blocks damage from the front.
audit.why: As written the player believes autos are permanently useless against him at level 1, when in reality the block is a long-cooldown, directional, cancellable channel — and Karma's Focused Resolve root cancels it outright. The page also never named Shield Vault's auto-reset or its 13/12/11/10/9s cooldown, which is the actual timer the whole lane is scheduled around.
audit.corrected: whys[0], spikes[0].text, early, wants.you[0] and wants.foe[1] rewritten around Shield Vault's point-and-click stun and its real cooldown; dosFull[1].d states that Focused Resolve cancels the Aegis Assault channel; dontsFull[0].d says not to dump poke into the frontal block.

edits.before: Q poke at level 1 is among the best in the game — chunk Pantheon on every last-hit and start the Mantra economy.
edits.after: He has Comet Spear poke and a point-and-click stun waiting — nothing to dodge, so you punish timers, not casts.

edits.before: His Aegis passive auto-blocks your Q-detonation autos and his point-click W stun ignores your range — you simply cannot trade into him at level 1.

edits.before: Pantheon's Aegis passive auto-blocks your Q detonation autos and the spears he throws at you, and his point-click W stun ignores your range entirely — his single hardest window, so do not contest the wave at melee.
edits.after: Shield Vault is point-and-click on a 13/12/11/10/9-second cooldown: no skillshot to sidestep, and it resets his auto into an empowered spear on a champion with no dash — his hardest window, so never contest the wave inside 600 units.

edits.before: Respect this — Pantheon is the rare melee who beats your range early. His Aegis passive auto-blocks point-blank autos and the spears he throws, and his W is a point-click stun (no skillshot to sidestep) that closes the gap you live on, so a clean W usually means an empowered-spear combo you cannot answer. Do not walk into W range to land Q; poke only with the tail of Inner Flame from max distance, and never burn E's shield-speed chasing a trade. Your one safe window is when his W is on cooldown — there is no dodging it, so you punish the timer, not the cast.
edits.after: Respect this — Pantheon is the rare melee who beats your range early. His W, Shield Vault, is a point-and-click dash-stun (no skillshot to sidestep) that closes the gap you live on, and it doubles as an auto-attack reset, so a clean W means an empowered-spear combo you cannot answer. Do not walk inside its 600 units to land Q; poke only with Inner Flame from max distance, and never burn E's shield-speed chasing a trade. Your safe window is its 13/12/11/10/9-second cooldown — there is no dodging it, so you punish the timer, not the cast.
